result.detail: Scope gaps for the tech lead: (a) req:AXIL-FORMAL needs a single prove-mode .sby. The properties already sit in the RTL under `ifdef FORMAL`, intended to be strong enough for induction (held-flag and bvalid invariants, response stability, response-follows-request, response-code policy) with covers on OKAY and SLVERR writes and a completed read. They are unproven until a formal_spec task submits the job file. (b) The microarchitecture's failure-path testbench (axi4_lite_regs_tb_fail.v) is not included. Adding a second testbench file to this submission would not change the simulator top, but I kept the deliverable to the stated outputs. (c) The two interpretation points in the design note (SLVERR on an unmapped empty-strobe write; read-before-write on a same-edge collision) should be confirmed in review. Neither contradicts the approved specs as I read them.
